For a custom unit today, subclass `ProgressColumn` and render `task.finished_speed or task.speed`; the [progress docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/progress.rst) describe custom columns. `TaskProgressColumn(show_speed=True)` displays `it/s` when the total is unknown, while `TransferSpeedColumn` assumes bytes. Feature requests need approval in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before an issue.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
